blind.description: A single modular half-timber wall section. It consists of a stout dark brown timber frame featuring two vertical posts, a bottom sill, a top beam, a horizontal middle rail, a lower central vertical strut, and curved upper corner braces forming an arched opening pattern. The spaces between the timber elements are filled with flat, cream/off-white plaster or wattle-and-daub panels. The geometry is clean, solid, and stylized with hand-painted textures, sitting directly flat on the ground with no plinth.
blind.from_above: A straight dark brown rectangular beam with slightly rounded post caps on either end.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 1.1 to 1.2 times as tall as the 5 ft 9 in figure (about 6.5-7 ft tall), and about 4.5 ft wide (spanning almost one full 5-ft grid tile).
